nodes.title: Add MaxMin clustering for binary molecular fingerprints
nodes.body:
## Changes

This PR introduces **MaxMin clustering** for binary molecular fingerprints, a diversity-driven, centroid-based clustering algorithm commonly used in cheminformatics.

### Key additions
- New `MaxMinClustering` estimator following the scikit-learn API (`fit`, `predict`, `fit_predict` + supporting cloning and pickling)
- Centroid selection via RDKit’s `MaxMinPicker` using a Tanimoto-distance threshold
- Assignment of samples to the nearest centroids by maximum Tanimoto similarity
- Support for dense NumPy arrays, SciPy sparse matrices, and RDKit `ExplicitBitVect` inputs
- Convenience method to retrieve clusters as index groups
- Comprehensive unit tests covering correctness, determinism, sparse/dense parity, error handling, cloning, and pickling
- New tutorial notebook: `10_molecular_clustering.ipynb`

## Checklist before requesting a review
- [x] Docstrings added/updated in public functions and classes
- [x] Tests added, reasonable test coverage (at least ~90%, `make test-coverage`)
- [x] Sphinx docs added/updated and render properly (`make docs` and see `docs/_build/index.html`)
